references.text: The same expression 'מָעַל' (treachery/adultery) is used for acting treacherously against the Lord
Uses the same introductory formula 'דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל' to introduce laws
Describes the consequences of adultery and shame that follow the one who commits adultery
The prophet uses the image of an unfaithful wife committing adultery to describe Israel's unfaithfulness toward God
Hosea speaks about the unfaithfulness and prostitution of his daughters and daughters-in-law
Describes the consequences for the guilty woman in the sotah ritual
Marriage is to be held in honor, and God will judge those who practice prostitution and adultery
